items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: No, I didn't know Tommy Ladner.

ctx.x: Sort of more classical kind of thing. That's right, that's right. That's right. Mm-hmm. Can you remember any of those other musicians over there, like they had Tommy Ladner there, I believe? Remember him? All right.
No, I didn't know Tommy Ladner.
He went up to New York, for sure. And then they had Bunkers over there sometimes, teaching some of those people.
